title: Uniform affine-hypercohomology bound for the space derived quasi-coherator
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated: it admits a surjective etale map from a quasi-compact scheme, and $U\times_X V$ is quasi-compact for every pair of affine etale scheme charts $U,V\to X$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Use the small etale structure sheaf and the equivalent small ringed model [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be its full triangulated subcategory of objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Let $DQ_X$ be the right adjoint of [lem-sfb-space-derived-coherator-adjunction]. For an affine etale scheme $u:U\to X$ and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, write $H^i(U,E)=H^i(R\Gamma(U,E))$, where $R\Gamma(U,-)$ is derived evaluation on the corresponding object of the small etale ringed site, computed by termwise sections of a K-injective resolution and forgetting the section-ring action [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. There is an integer $N\geq0$, depending only on $X$, such that for all integers $a\leq b$ and every $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ the following implication holds: if $H^i(U,E)=0$ for every affine etale $U\to X$ and every $i\notin[a,b]$, then $$H^i(DQ_XE)=0\quad\text{for every }i\notin[a,b+N].$$ The conclusion concerns cohomology sheaves. No quasi-coherence or boundedness of $E$ is assumed.

proof.text: For each qcqs etale algebraic space $W\to X$, let $P(W)$ assert the stated uniform implication for $DQ_W$, with one $N_W\geq0$ for all $a\leq b$ and $E$. This property is invariant under isomorphism. Apply [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-distinguished-square-induction]: it remains to prove the affine case and closure under its elementary distinguished squares. All smaller vertices in that principle are qcqs, so their coherators exist by [lem-sfb-space-derived-coherator-adjunction].

If $W=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is affine, its identity is one of the affine etale tests. Thus $R\Gamma(W,E)$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$. By [lem-sfb-space-affine-coherator-formula], $DQ_WE\cong a_A R\Gamma(W,E)$. The cohomology isomorphisms of [lem-sfb-affine-etale-derived-module-realization] give $H^i(DQ_WE)\cong a_A H^i(R\Gamma(W,E))$. This vanishes outside $[a,b]$, so take $N_W=0$, including the empty affine scheme.

Consider a square $(U\subset W,V\to W)$ of the induction, put $T=U\times_WV$, and assume $P(U),P(V),P(T)$. For $A=U,V,T$, restriction is exact slice restriction by [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus]. It preserves K-injectives: the exact left adjoint of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-sheaf-slice-adjunction] takes any acyclic complex $C$ to an acyclic complex, so every map $C\to I|_A$ is null-homotopic by adjunction and [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. For any affine etale $B\to A$, sections of $I|_A$ on $B$ equal sections of $I$ on the composite $B\to W$. Hence $H^i(B,E|_A)=H^i(B,E)$, and $E|_A$ has the required test bounds.

proof.text: By the three inductive hypotheses, $Q_A=DQ_A(E|_A)$ has quasi-coherent cohomology only in $[a,b+N_A]$. The maps $j_A:A\to W$ are qcqs by [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-permanence]. As $W$ is quasi-compact, [lem-sfb-space-derived-pushforward-upper-bound] supplies $c_A\geq1$ independent of $E,a,b$ such that $B_A=Rj_{A,*}Q_A$ vanishes in degrees $i\geq b+N_A+c_A$. The exact restriction and derived adjunction of [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus], with clause (1) of [lem-pur-exact-derived-adjunction-bounds], also give $H^i(B_A)=0$ for $i<a$.

Apply [lem-sfb-space-coherator-distinguished-square-triangle] and the cohomology sequence of [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact]. Its segment is $H^{i-1}(B_T)\to H^i(DQ_WE)\to H^i(B_U)\oplus H^i(B_V)$. Put $M=\max_{A=U,V,T}(N_A+c_A-1)\geq0$. All $B_A$ vanish outside $[a,b+M]$. If $i<a$, both ends of this segment vanish; if $i>b+M+1$, both ends again vanish. Thus $N_W=M+1$ works. It depends only on the chosen square and its three constants, not on $a,b,E$.

The affine and gluing conditions are now established. The induction principle [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-distinguished-square-induction] gives $P(X)$, which is exactly the assertion. Every constructed constant is nonnegative, and all restrictions and the triangle allowed arbitrary unbounded $E$.

lean.statement: theorem derivedCoherator_affineHypercohomology_bound {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.SmallModules] (hqc : ∃ (U : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj), CompactSpace U.left ∧ IsEtale a ∧ IsSurjective a) (hqs : ∀ (U V : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X.obj.obj), IsAffine U.left → IsAffine V.left → IsEtale a → IsEtale b → ∃ W : Over S, Nonempty (yoneda.obj W ≅ Limits.pullback a b) ∧ CompactSpace W.left) (DQ : X.DerivedModules ⥤ X.DerivedQCoh) (adj : X.derivedQCohProperty.ι ⊣ DQ) : ∃ N : ℤ, 0 ≤ N ∧ ∀ (a b : ℤ), a ≤ b → ∀ (E : X.DerivedModules) (I : CochainComplex X.SmallModules ℤ), I.IsKInjective → Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ E) → (∀ (U : X.SmallEtaleModel) (i : ℤ), (i < a ∨ b < i) → IsZero ((((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.smallStructureRings ⋙ sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleModelTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙ (evaluation X.SmallEtaleModelᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I).homology i)) → ∀ i : ℤ, (i < a ∨ b + N < i) → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj (DQ.obj E).obj)
lean.note: Affine hypercohomology is expanded directly as homology of termwise abelian sections of any K-injective representative of E on the existing small affine etale model; every affine chart is isomorphic to a chart in this skeleton. The conclusion uses cohomology sheaves of the underlying existing D_QCoh object. No new notion or additional boundedness hypothesis.
